name: Anganwadi Workers Welfare Fund
benefit: - A minimum amount of ₹30,000/- will be provided. - Upon completing 20 years of service, ₹1,30,000/- will be provided. **Note**: There is a provision for a 5% annual increase on the deposited amount.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be an Anganwadi woman worker/mini worker/assistant working on an honorarium basis. 1. The applicant must have completed 60 years of age.
